_comment: Exemptions for tools/secret_scan.py. Every entry is a VERIFIED false positive with a written reason (25+ characters); never exempt a real secret. `secret_scan.py --tracked` (CI and drift invariant 21) fails on an entry whose pattern_id is unknown, whose path is not tracked, or that no longer exempts any match in its file; commit-message entries are checked for pattern id and reason only. commit_policy_boundary is the SHA of the commit that introduced the commit-and-PR hygiene policy: commits at or before it predate the policy (they carry session trailers by design and history is not rewritten); the CI backstop checks only commits after it. An entry pins the exact text it exempts as match_sha256 (the sha256 printed beside each finding), so it never exempts a later, different match of the same pattern in the same file; an entry with no pin exempts nothing.
